checks.name: All strength/direction cases use the same complete physical initial state, with A/B identical wind schedules and control frequencies
Plot height error derives from actual retained states; chosen matrix B exactly reexecutes every decision and terminal state
Finite-supply failures, partial windows and never-started cases remain distinct, without imputed zero error or a winner
Matrix archive verifies its summaries against the original full records and rejects altered metrics

summary.metricScope: Distribution uses every attempted full 2–6 s window, including later failed landings. Partial-window statistics remain in each record and do not enter four-second distributions. Full-task gas includes failed/cancelled shorter tasks and must be read with outcome/duration.
summary.probabilityScope: Success fraction describes only these declared deterministic cases. Three seeds are not a population reliability estimate.

limitations: Numerical fixed-step solver only; native pixels and user GPU acceptance are separate.
Three declared seeds per direction are sensitivity cases, not a population reliability probability.
This experiment changes only the height outer-loop controller; horizontal control is shared.
